description: Psion learning, resource spending, combat and persistence through low/middle/high progression in the real engine.
prerequisites: Disposable legal fixture with Psion and the read-only checkpoint helper; six legally created discipline actors or their local saves.
Controlled hostile and friendly combat targets, ordinary and temple rest access, and a second area.
Local XP grants are permitted for preparation; all subsequent level-up, learning, casting and persistence transitions must execute in GemRB.
Expected PP, learning credits, power eligibility, DC resources and progression values are derived independently from current rules and installed resources.
instructions: Record before/after learning credits and known powers for confirm and cancel, and compare each discipline's visible eligible powers at each unlocked tier.
Observe PP before and after a legal manifestation, insufficient-PP attempt, target cancellation and legal/over-limit augmentation. Include actual values, not a claimed pass flag.
For DC selection change current Intelligence through a controlled game effect, cast again and record the actual selected resource against its installed INT-specific oracle.
Exercise focus, Center Mind, feats, skills and quickslots through their real UI actions; observe combat effects and resource changes.
Level through the real screens at low, middle and level 17+ checkpoints, including high-tier access for every discipline.
Observe ordinary rest, temple rest, area transition and save/reload against recorded baselines or the applicable reset rule. Quit normally.
